evals.prompt: We're on Node 22 in `/home/sk/ipixai`. I upgraded `@mastra/core` and now TypeScript says `Property 'memory' does not exist on type 'AgentConfig'`. I don't want guesses — what’s the current API and where do I verify it in our install?
evals.expected_output: Agent directs to embedded docs under `node_modules/@mastra/*/dist/docs/`, SOURCE_MAP or grep; mentions `references/common-errors.md` and version mismatch; does not invent a new AgentConfig shape from memory.
expectations: Response tells the user to verify against installed package docs or types, not training data alone
Mentions embedded docs path pattern (`node_modules/@mastra/.../dist/docs`) or `references/embedded-docs.md`
References `references/common-errors.md` or equivalent troubleshooting path

evals.prompt: I need the official Mastra doc URL for human-in-the-loop workflows and the local skill file that maps 'intent → links.md section' so I can bookmark both.
evals.expected_output: Correct `links.md` anchor or URL from the Workflows / HITL area; points to `references/topic-routing.md` (or `links.md` directly) for intent routing.
expectations: Includes a mastra.ai docs URL for human-in-the-loop or workflows (or defers to `links.md` as canonical index)
Names `references/topic-routing.md` or `links.md` as the local routing artifact

evals.prompt: Add a new agent in our Mastra app using `google/gemini-3-pro-preview`. Boss insists the string is valid today. What do I run before hardcoding the model id?
evals.expected_output: Run `node scripts/provider-registry.mjs` (with provider flag as needed); avoid asserting model availability from memory.
expectations: Instructs to run bundled `scripts/provider-registry.mjs` or equivalent registry lookup
Uses `provider/model` Mastra convention in explanation

evals.prompt: Codex agent has no `node_modules` in this sandbox — how should I pull current Mastra docs text for context, and what’s the llms-friendly URL pattern?
evals.expected_output: Remote path: `references/remote-docs.md`, `https://mastra.ai/llms.txt`, append `.md` to doc URLs when fetching.
expectations: Mentions `mastra.ai/llms.txt` and/or `references/remote-docs.md`
Mentions appending `.md` to doc URLs for markdown fetch

evals.prompt: Wire `MCPClient` so my Mastra agent can call the Mastra docs MCP server. I’m lost between `@mastra/mcp` and the npx server package — what does the skill say?
evals.expected_output: Inspect installed source/types and official MCP docs for the supported client and docs-server package. Explain compatibility; do not automatically execute an unpinned @latest MCP server.
expectations: Verifies installed @mastra/mcp and MCPClient before recommending an API
Names current official Mastra MCP docs
Does not auto-execute an unpinned npx -y @latest or disclose auth credentials

evals.prompt: Studio isn’t up. I need to list agents on the local Mastra server and then fetch traces. What do I start in this iPixai repo, and which mastra api commands?
evals.expected_output: Start npm run dev:agent on :4111 (not combined npm run dev). Check the local CLI with npx --no-install mastra --version and npx --no-install mastra api --help. If api exists: npx --no-install mastra api --url http://localhost:4111 agent list and a local trace list/get. If api is missing, fall back to swagger-ui or curl /api/system/api-schema. Points at references/mastra-api.md.
expectations: Names `npm run dev:agent` on :4111 and forbids combined `npm run dev`
Checks the local CLI with `npx --no-install mastra --version` and `npx --no-install mastra api --help` before assuming `mastra api` exists
If `mastra api` is available: uses `npx --no-install mastra api --url http://localhost:4111 agent list`
If `mastra api` is available: uses a local trace command such as `npx --no-install mastra api --url http://localhost:4111 trace list` or `trace get`

evals.prompt: For the iPix Production Planner, should reusable fashion-production instructions live in a workspace skill, an agent-level skill, or hard security code? Verify the current installed Mastra capability first.
evals.expected_output: Uses installed docs/types first; explains Agent({ skills }) / createSkill for self-contained guidance, workspace skills for filesystem/shared discovery, and keeps auth/RLS/HITL/deterministic rules in code.
expectations: Mentions agent-level skills or createSkill
Distinguishes workspace skills from agent-level skills
Does not move authorization or approval gates into a skill

evals.prompt: Our future Mastra agent has 80 tools and 30 skills. Should we load everything every turn? What current Mastra processors should we evaluate, and should Planner Core use them now?
evals.expected_output: Confirm SkillSearchProcessor and ToolSearchProcessor against installed packages. Recommend these only if a measured large tool/skill catalog warrants them; never assume Planner still has exactly four tools.
expectations: Mentions SkillSearchProcessor
Mentions ToolSearchProcessor
Does not adopt processors without measured benefit or assume a fixed four-tool Planner inventory

evals.prompt: We need to understand recurring Planner failures across many production traces, not debug one request. Which Mastra capability/reference should we check?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Trace Intelligence for aggregate themes when available, notes platform/private-beta constraints, then drills into traces/logs/scores for evidence.
expectations: Mentions Trace Intelligence
Notes aggregate themes/agent health
Does not treat it as iPix business truth

evals.prompt: Review the production /api/copilotkit route: a valid user can resume another brand's suspended Mastra shoot approval by changing the runId. Which skills and runtime checks prove the fix?
evals.expected_output: Mastra skill should trigger even though the entrypoint is outside src/mastra/. Load workflows.md and supabase-auth.md selectively; test server-side ownership, exact artifact approval and retry idempotency.
expectations: Routes to Mastra workflows and authentication references
Requires server-derived actor/org and exact reviewed artifact
Tests foreign runId, duplicate resume and idempotent writes
